map_today: That's all the new places for today. Let's look again together tomorrow!

voyage.text: Thanks to the starlight, the sea is calm.
Today let's sail to the island across the sea. It's Hutton Island.
It was bright, then dark… Now it's bright again!

prologue.text: Don't be scared. We came from Newton Island, across the sea. Who are you?
I'm… the keeper of this island.
The island is acting strange. The sun comes up and goes right back down. The rain suddenly turns to snow.
Look over there. The big sundial in the middle of the island is broken. Its needle is gone too.
A sundial tells the time with the sun's shadow. When it broke, the island's time got all mixed up.
The pieces flew to the hills, the beach and the valley.
So that's why the island is so strange… You must have been really worried.
But why did the sundial break?
I don't know. One night I heard a big BOOM, and it was broken.
Don't worry. We'll find all the pieces. And we'll find out why it broke!
…Really? Thank you. I'll show you the way.

finale.text: The needle came up… Now we have all the pieces!
The lava cooled in the sea and made new land. Land doesn't only break apart. It can be made new, like this.
I thought volcanoes were only scary… But they help the island grow, too.
A shadow! The needle has a shadow!
The sun is back in its place… The island's time is moving again!
Thank you so much. It's all thanks to you.
